name: agency-starter
description: Kundenneutraler Eleventy-Starter für individuelle Websites lokaler Unternehmen.

scripts.lint:js: node --check .eleventy.js && node --check src/js/main.js && node --check scripts/validate-data.js && node --check scripts/validate-output.js && node --check scripts/serve-output.js
scripts.check:deploy: npm run build && npm run lint:js && npm run validate:data && npm run validate:output
scripts.check: npm run check:deploy && npm run test:browser
scripts.check:production: npm run validate:data:production && npm run build:production && npm run lint:js && cross-env BUILD_CONTEXT=production npm run validate:output && npm run test:browser
